name: URL → document-tree
description: Give a URL of content (paper, article, YouTube video), get back a document-tree: a deterministic node skeleton over typed spans, stored content-addressed under docs-cache/<hash>/ with the raw (potentially adversarial) source beside it. Consume what you want — tree.jsonl carries every node's span so the verbatim text is one read away. Params: url (required), agent (who to notify), budget (L0 lines, default 120), lang (youtube captions, default en). KNOWN LIMIT: core:exec runs cmd.exe, so a URL containing & or | must be passed bare-host (e.g. youtu.be/<id> works; ?si=... query tails do not).
